job.title: Salesforce Developer
job.description:
Senior Salesforce Developers (Contractors) are required for an immediate start to join a major Salesforce Flow Migration project team. This is a full-time contract role offering a daily rate of $969 per day including super, running until the end of December 2026 with the potential for extension.

The position operates under a hybrid working model, requiring a minimum of 2 days per week in the Sydney CBD office.
 
About the Organisation
a NSW Government department who manage complex, high-stakes democratic and administrative processes. Our technology division is currently undergoing significant modernization, offering a dynamic and complex application environment where your expertise will directly impact critical public infrastructure.
 
The Role
As a Senior Salesforce Developer, you will focus on high-volume automation technology within a dedicated project team. You will report directly to the Salesforce Development Team Lead while collaborating closely with the Program Manager to deliver robust, scalable solutions under tight timeframes.
 
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, configure, and test Salesforce solutions with a primary focus on Salesforce automation technology and Flow migrations.
  • Deliver high-quality code and development services that strictly align with established technical standards and architectural directions.
  • Manage automated deployments and version control within a structured pipeline.
  • Navigate system interdependencies to anticipate and mitigate technical problems in a dynamic environment with conflicting user needs.   
      
  • Provide concise technical advice to team leaders and stakeholders to ensure seamless data management and external integrations.

 
Key Requirements

  • Salesforce Automation Expertise: Extensive experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and migrating Process Builders/Workflows to Salesforce Flows.
  • Data & Integration Skills: Strong understanding of the Salesforce data model (objects, fields, relationships) alongside proven experience developing Salesforce APIs and web services for external integrations.
  • CI/CD Tools: Proficient in managing deployments using tools like Azure DevOps or Gearset.
  • Quality Focus: Proven track record of ensuring code quality through comprehensive unit testing.
  • Certifications: Salesforce Platform Developer I or II certification is highly desirable, or equivalent deep professional experience acting as a platform SME.
  • Education: Relevant tertiary qualifications in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

 
What’s on Offer

  • Highly competitive market rate of $969/day inc. super
  • Initial contract until the end of December 2026 with potential extension.
  • Immediate start (standard agency notice periods respected).
  • Hybrid work flexibility.

job.title: Senior Cyber Security Engineer
job.description:
Senior Cyber Security Engineer
Location: Western Sydney
Contract: 12 months

We are seeking an experienced Senior Cyber Security Engineer to support a major cyber resilience and security uplift program within a large, complex enterprise environment.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role with a strong focus on network security, segmentation, DNS security, identity, security architecture, monitoring, hardening and recovery. You will work across multiple security initiatives, taking solutions from technical design through implementation, testing and transition into operations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement enterprise network security controls, including segmentation, firewalls, secure remote access and security zones
  • Engineer security capabilities across WAF, protective DNS, DNS filtering, NDR, SIEM/MDR, MFA, IGA and PAM
    Develop secure network architectures across cloud and on-premises environments
  • Perform technical security assurance, vulnerability assessment, configuration reviews and control testing
    Support security automation using PowerShell, Python, Terraform and APIs
  • Work closely with architecture, network, cloud, infrastructure, identity and application teams

About You

You will bring senior-level experience designing and implementing enterprise security solutions in complex hybrid environments, with strong knowledge of TCP/IP, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs, WAF, network access controls and DNS security. Experience delivering security controls across large cyber uplift or resilience programs will be highly regarded.

Hands-on experience with logging/SOC environments, operating system hardening and identity/access integration is also required.

Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GIAC, Microsoft Security or AWS/Azure Security certifications are desirable.

This is an excellent 12-month opportunity for a senior cyber security engineer who enjoys remaining hands-on while contributing to large-scale security and resilience initiatives.

To apply or discuss the opportunity further, please contact Tim Moynihan at tim.moynihan@eitr.com.au.

Senior-level transformation and executive stakeholder management experience will be highly regarded.
